req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Location header must be set correctly when a new player is created. This is crucial for RESTful API design, as it allows clients to know where the newly created resource can be accessed. The tests will ensure that this behavior is implemented correctly, covering positive, negative, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
No player exists with squad number 27.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid new player payload.
expected: The Location header is set to /players/squadnumber/27.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/27'

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_negative
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
A player already exists with squad number 1.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a payload containing an existing squad number.
expected: The response does not contain a Location header.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

existing_player = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=existing_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert 'Location' not in response.headers

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_boundary
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
No player exists with squad number 0.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a payload containing squad number 0.
expected: The Location header is set to /players/squadnumber/0.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_player = {
